# Design Atlas

Frontend design references with human previews and machine-readable context.
The source of truth is entries/, patterns/, materials/, research/, demos/, and material-demos/. Brand studies are dated
snapshots; their fidelity boundaries and asset attribution travel with each case.

- [Agent workflow](AGENT.md): keyword search, complete context, source retrieval and export.
- [Catalog](agent/catalog.json): candidate summaries and case bundle paths.
- [Design patterns](agent/patterns.json): visual, micro-motion, page-motion, sound, and structure mechanisms with triggers, effects, constraints, composition guidance, evidence and bundle paths.
- [Materials](agent/materials.json): independently reusable resources with interactive demos, pinned upstream versions, license scope, constraints and bundle paths.
- [Human material library](materials.html): browse resources and adjust their runnable examples.
- [Overview](index.html): introductions to cases, the design lab and the Agent workflow.
- [Human preview](cases.html): interactive browsing, comparisons and demos.
- [Human pattern library](patterns.html): browse atoms, filter by source case, and return to the complete case.
- [Skill](https://github.com/MIBXR/mibxr-skills/tree/main/skills/design-atlas): explore the latest catalog, refine candidates through conversation, and retrieve complete context within one pinned session.

Read catalog first, then agent/cases/<id>.json. Case bundles preserve the original
entry, full documents, and file paths and roles. Get source only when selected.
Resolve the latest default-branch SHA at the start of a new session, then use
that same SHA for catalog, bundle and files. Refresh explicitly to discover
newly added cases. Adapt mechanisms to actual user requirements and owned assets.

For cross-case composition, read agent/patterns.json and follow paths.bundle.
Each bundle keeps the complete pattern and sourceCases with case bundle paths.
Use sourceCases and sourceFiles to retrieve runnable dependencies.
Keep case and pattern indexes, bundles and files on one pinned SHA. Respect
observed/adapted/inferred provenance and each atom's keyboard/reduced-motion
guidance. Pattern composition roles and links guide adaptation, not rigid rules.
Case bundles include patternIds. The skill supports pattern-search, pattern-show
and pattern-export. For an unmerged PR or the exact live Site version, explicitly
pin the full source.commit SHA; latest default-branch discovery stays separate.

For components, images, sound, fonts and other resources, read agent/materials.json
and follow paths.bundle. Material
bundles preserve the complete material, original documents and all runnable
dependencies in files. sourceFiles identifies the main source to inspect; it
does not replace the complete file manifest. Use material-search, material-show
and material-export in the skill. Keep material indexes, bundles and files on
the same pinned SHA as cases and patterns. Read upstream version, license scope,
constraints and demos before adapting; a static fallback does not verify GPU
execution. Repositories without catalog.materials keep their case/pattern flow.

Load case, pattern and material indexes only when needed; a missing unrelated
index does not block retrieval. The fixed Git commit is the content version.
